name: @outpipe/sdks-monorepo
description: Official multi-language SDKs and framework integrations for Outpipe

scripts.build:packages: npm run build:types --workspace packages/sdk && npm run build --workspace packages/sdk && npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace packages/hono && npm run build --workspace packages/tanstack-start && npm run build --workspace packages/react && npm run build --workspace packages/vite-plugin && npm run build --workspace packages/next && npm run build --workspace packages/nest && npm run build --workspace packages/express && npm run build --workspace packages/angular
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:go && npm run test:rust && npm run test:php
scripts.test:go: cd packages/go && go vet ./... && go test ./...
scripts.test:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path packages/rust/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo test --manifest-path packages/rust/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:php: cd packages/php && composer validate --strict --no-check-publish && composer test && composer check
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:types --workspace packages/sdk && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
